Furthermore, the lack of any dividend yield [E3] provides no compensation to shareholders for the extreme risk associated with a company whose sales growth has cratered by 55% to 74% across all measured timeframes [E12, E13, E14, E15]. Ultimately, the negative P/E of -11.44x [E5] and the absence of top-line growth [E51, E57] demonstrate that the company is not merely undervalued, but fundamentally failing to participate in the 17.6% growth seen across the sector [E62].
